card.architecture: LongCat-Image (Meituan) Flux-family MMDiT edit model; Qwen2.5-VL encoder + Flux VAE. Runs the Qwen-Image-Edit topology (TextEncodeQwenImageEditPlus) via clip_type longcat_image. Q5_K_M GGUF.
card.summary: Meituan's instruction editor on a Flux-class backbone, fp8/GGUF-light (transformer ~4.7GB). Strong identity/scene consistency and text rendering; reuses the Qwen2.5-VL encoder and Flux VAE already installed.
use_cases: text edits with strong glyph fidelity
card.pick_when: You want a fast, light instruction editor that runs comfortably on 24GB and reuses the Qwen encoder/VAE.

prompt.guidance: Provide an input image + imperative instruction.
prompt.example: (with input image) Put a red baseball cap on her and change the background to a beach
prompt.overview: Plain natural-language edit instructions. Supports semantic (high-level, identity-preserving) and appearance (precise local) edits; phrase to match intent. Multi-image references supported via image2/image3.

negative.note: Runs true CFG ~4 with an empty negative (guidance_embeds false).

speed.note: Q5_K_M GGUF transformer ~4.7GB; light on a 3090.

ui_help.note: Edits an existing image from an instruction.

edit_use_cases: instruction editing on a Flux-class backbone: add/remove/replace, recolour, background, relight; strong consistency and text

reference.hint: Your photo is image 1; your attached references are image 2 and image 3. Refer to them by number.
